sources.label: Official Aritzia size guide (All Brands Exclusive to Aritzia › Original, CM)

audit: Old /en/customer-service/size-guide 404s; guide is /intl/en/size-guide (read with its CM toggle on; IN toggle agrees). Old rows paired letters one-to-one with UK/US/EU sizes Aritzia doesn't print, and were 1-5 cm off: XS 79/61/85 -> 81.5-84/61-63.5/86.5-89; M 87/69/93 -> 91.5-95.5/71-75/96.5-100.5; XL 96/78/102 -> 106.5-110.5/86.5-90/112-115.5. Old XXS removed (chart prints 2XS and 3XS). Separate numeric (00-16), denim, sizes 1-3 and Curve Fit charts exist and aren't stored. UK/US/EU removed (not published).
